sources.title: RedHatAI/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-speculator.dspark · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: RedHatAI/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-speculator.dspark This is a DSpark speculator model for Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B. Training Details This model was trained using the Speculators library library on a subset of Magpie-Align/Magpie-Llama-3.1-Pro-300K-Filtered and the train_sft split of HuggingFaceH4/ultrachat_200k. Responses were regenerated by Qwen3.6-35B-A3B.

sources.title: DSpark - Speculators Docs
sources.snippet: The draft model subclasses DFlash, so the architecture and training pipeline are otherwise unchanged, and it can be paired with any supported verifier. Serving uses vLLM's own dspark method ("method": "dspark" in --speculative-config).
